about.title: Healdsburg Car Accident Claims
about.longDescription: Healdsburg is a small city, but its roads carry a steady mix of local traffic, wine-country visitors, and drivers passing through on US-101. Public records show 18 injury collisions and 21 injured people in the most recent final crash year, with reports clustering on Saturday afternoons between 4 and 6 p.m. — a pattern likely tied to weekend traffic on corridors like Healdsburg Avenue and Dry Creek Road. When a collision happens here, the aftermath can feel overwhelming: medical visits, missed work, a car that needs repair, and an insurance adjuster calling before you've even seen a doctor. LawProactive doesn't practice law or take a fee itself; we simply connect you, free of charge, with an independent personal injury attorney who can evaluate what happened and explain your options. That attorney works on contingency, meaning there's no upfront cost and no fee unless your case results in a recovery. Our goal is to help you get organized and matched quickly, so you can focus on healing instead of paperwork.

whyChoose.title: Why Act Sooner Rather Than Later

items.title: California's Filing Clock
items.desc: California generally allows two years from the crash date to file a personal injury claim, but if a government vehicle or roadway defect was involved, that window can shrink to as little as six months. An attorney can help identify which deadline applies to your situation before it passes.

items.title: Comparative Fault Can Reduce, Not Erase, Your Claim
items.desc: California follows pure comparative fault, so even if you're found partly responsible for the crash, you may still recover damages reduced by your share of fault. Having someone evaluate the evidence early can help make sure fault isn't unfairly assigned to you.

items.title: Skip the Recorded Statement
items.desc: The other driver's insurer may ask for a recorded statement soon after the crash — it's not required, and anything you say can be used to minimize your claim. An independent attorney can speak on your behalf and help preserve evidence like photos, witness contacts, and crash reports before it disappears.

items.question: What should I do right after a crash on Healdsburg Avenue or Dry Creek Road?
items.answer: If you're able, take photos of the vehicles, road conditions, and any visible injuries, and get contact information from witnesses. Seek medical attention even if injuries seem minor, since some symptoms show up later. Avoid giving a recorded statement to the other driver's insurance company until you've spoken with an attorney.

items.question: How long do I have to file a claim after a car accident in Healdsburg?
items.answer: California generally gives you two years from the date of the crash to file a personal injury lawsuit. If a government entity, like the city or county, may be responsible, that deadline can be as short as six months, so it's worth getting guidance early.

items.question: Will it cost me anything to talk to an attorney through LawProactive?
items.answer: No. LawProactive's connection service is free, and the independent attorneys in the network work on contingency, meaning they only get paid if you receive a recovery. There's no upfront cost to have your situation reviewed.
